en: Color aerial view of a medium‑sized town at the foot of a large green mountain. The urban area is dense with low- to mid-rise apartment blocks and red-tiled roofs, surrounded by factories and fields in the foreground and scattered houses and farmland extending into the valley. The mountain behind has steep slopes and a relatively flat ridgeline. The sky is blue with a few clouds. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.
